name: gwaihir, greatest of the eagles
mana cost: {4}{W}
types: legendary creature bird noble
power toughness: 5/5
static: flying
triggered: whenever CARDNAME attacks, target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn.
triggered: at the beginning of each end step, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, create a 3/3 white bird creature token with flying and "whenever this token attacks, target attacking creature gains flying until end of turn."
